rows.ARS:
Mauve or mauve blend Grandiflora.
Registration name: MEIskimov
rows.Origin:
Bred by Meilland International (France, 2004).
Introduced in United States by Star Roses & Plants (Pennsylvania) in 2005.
rows.Bloom: Lavender. [Lilac.]. Strong, citrus, rose fragrance. 17 to 25 petals. Average diameter 4.75". Large, double (17-25 petals), in small clusters, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, upright. Semi-glossy, medium green foliage.

Height: 4'11" to 6'1" (150 to 185cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders, garden or landscape. Disease susceptibility: susceptible to blackspot . Remove spent blooms to encourage re-bloom. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
rows.Breeder's notes: More tolerant to disease than most other lavender roses on the market today.
